newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated gets $100 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated gets $100 mln credit facility.

text.p: Consolidated Graphics Inc said Tuesday it had signed a $100 million credit facility covering the next three years.
The agreement has a Libor-based pricing structure and replaces the company's existing $50 million facility.
"By doubling the size of our credit facility we have access to the necesssary financial capital to continue our aggressive acquisition program," said Chief Executive Joe Davis.
Consolidated said Chase Securities acted as lead manager for the six-member bank group providing the credit facility.
